goal: From the third Review round, admit a new blocking finding only when it touches the latest rework delta or crosses a security, data-loss, or authority boundary, using a durably persisted per-round review revision.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S1 in docs/specs/review-convergence.spec.md: a review-authored request_rework persists its ReviewRevisionIdentityV1 on the round history entry as an optional field validated against git_base_head; Review round 3 and later receive prior_review_commit and delta_paths in the manifest; a round>=3 blocking finding with violated.kind other than security_boundary and no caller_chain path in delta_paths is rejected for resubmission, while in-delta or security_boundary findings are admitted; rounds 1-2 and legacy records without a prior revision behave unchanged and never block on the missing fact.
